messages:
alex: FYI I opened a tiny PR to update the migration guide links for the new API paths. Docs preview is failing linkcheck + vale, blocking merge. CI output: `docs/preview:linkcheck (2 failed)`, `docs/preview:vale (3 errors)`. Can someone grab it?

maria: I can take a look in ~30m. Do we know which links are failing?

alex: The linkcheck log points to two internal relative links that now 404 after the nav restructure: `/guides/auth` -> should be `/guides/authentication/`. Also one anchor changed in the schema page. Vale errors are two passive-voice flags and one sentence-length > 120 chars.

sam: If it's just anchors/paths we can add redirects in config or fix the md. Redirects are heavier. I'd prefer updating the md to the new path and adding a short comment.

maria: I'll patch the two links and squash the passive voice bits. Quick fix: replace `(/guides/auth)` -> `(/guides/authentication/)` and shorten the long sentence.

jess: Note: docs/preview also runs markdownlint which flagged an unmatched fenced codeblock in the same file earlier. Might be related. Watch for that when editing.

docs-ci-bot: docs/preview build 1913645901 — linkcheck failed: 2 broken links; vale reported 3 suggestions. See https://ci.redwood/run/1913645901/results

maria: Pushed a commit that updates paths and fixes the code fence. Also added `<!--nolint:vale-->` inline for the one phrase that deliberately breaks the style rule (API-first term). If anyone objects to nolint, say now.

alex: Thanks — leaning on nolint is OK for deliberate product terms, but add a short inline comment explaining why.

sam: Can you paste the small diff here? makes it easier for a quick glance.

maria: Sure — diff: 

```diff
- See /guides/auth for setup.
+ See /guides/authentication/ for setup. <!-- redirect note: old /guides/auth -> authentication -->
```

And I wrapped a bad code fence: ```yaml
server: default
```

jess: LGTM. One minor Vale suggestion left but it's not blocking.

docs-ci-bot: docs/preview build 1913646105 — all checks passed ✅ (linkcheck, vale, markdownlint). Preview URL: https://preview.redwood/docs/1913646105

alex: Awesome — can we merge before the RC branch cut at 14:00 PT? We have a small release window and this affects the migration docs.

sam: If CI is green and it's a docs-only change, we can fast-merge once a reviewer + one approver sign off. @jess can you approve?

jess: Approved. go ahead. :+1:

maria: Merged and pushed to main, will follow up with a backport PR to release/rc.

alex: Thanks all. Leaving a note in the release checklist.

sam: Small follow-up: consider adding a redirect entry for `/guides/auth` in the docs-config for a smoother upgrade experience. Can file a follow-up issue.

alex: Filed ISSUE-412 in the docs backlog. Closing thread.
